_comment: Fragment 57 — the six Lane B entries D-102 answers, each anchored to its own file so graph-coverage can reach it. Merged 2026-08-24.

nodes.label: B-013 — A Critic Pass Cannot Certify the Artifact Set That Followed It
nodes.description: One artifact recorded both that its own critic pass was owed on a later turn and that the closure condition requiring that pass was met. The recorded review covered the predecessor commit, not the final one.
nodes.rationale: Asking the Judge whether the condition was met produced two answers from the same document. The pass was performed by the build lane rather than the orchestration lane, which is more independent than the rule requires and is not what the rule assigns, so both facts are recorded and neither substitutes for the other.

nodes.label: B-014 — The Removed Duplicate Runbook Came Back Untracked
nodes.description: A divergent duplicate of the propagation runbook, deleted by an earlier entry, exists again at the same path as an untracked file, and is being offered as the available skill. It repeats the defect that was removed: a shared-core triple naming two files and omitting the third.
nodes.rationale: Untracked and outside the documentation tree, so graph coverage and the source sweep are both blind to it. The repository can pass every governed check while an active procedure instructs an incomplete propagation.

nodes.label: B-015 — The Condition Gave Both Failure Directions for One Mechanism
nodes.description: A required status check that never reports stays pending and blocks the merge. The condition described a missing context as configured-but-never-gating in one sentence and as fail-closed in another.
nodes.rationale: The business consequence is preserved either way — delivery stops — but the direction determines whether it stops visibly or silently, and a document asserting both directions cannot guide the act it governs.

nodes.label: B-016 — The Required-Check Transition Is Not Ready to Apply
nodes.description: A workflow on another lane's surface was edited while that lane was not the selected active one and while its settings dependency had no disposition. The proposed compatibility job is not equivalent to the verification job it stands in for.
nodes.rationale: Acknowledgement is receipt, not authorization or closure. The Judge subsequently ruled the edit is kept and committed with the crossing declared, which answers the withdrawal request by decision and leaves the job's own defect untouched.

nodes.label: B-017 — The Closure Controls Accepted Malformed and Self-Verified Records
nodes.description: Required routing fields were removed from three entries and the check still passed, because its field pattern could cross a newline and read the following metadata line. The same parser shape governed the closure check.
nodes.rationale: A control-integrity defect rather than a cosmetic one: the green result did not describe the files being judged. Every other entry's evidence is read through the same two functions.

nodes.label: B-018 — The Uniqueness Check Could Pass With No Canonical Runbook
nodes.description: The check invoked a text filter absent on this platform, swallowed the resulting error, and reported one canonical file for every count other than more than one, including zero.
nodes.rationale: Discovery failing was indistinguishable from discovering nothing, and the detail line stated a count the check had never measured. Closing the entry it was written for would have rested on a result that proved nothing.
